exampleNotes.title: Sound focus
exampleNotes.body: After a sibilant, -es forms an extra /ɪz/ syllable.

rules: Most verbs add -s in the third-person singular.
Verbs ending in s, x, ch, sh or o normally add -es.
Consonant+y changes to -ies; have and be are common irregular forms.
After a voiceless non-sibilant sound, the ending is /s/.
After a vowel or voiced non-sibilant sound, the ending is /z/.
After a sibilant, -es is /ɪz/ and adds a syllable.

questions.question: She ___ tennis.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The third-person singular adds s.

questions.question: He ___ TV.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: watch adds es.

questions.question: Tom ___ hard.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: study changes to studies.

questions.question: How does the ending of likes sound?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: likes ends in /s/.

questions.question: How does the ending of plays sound?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: plays ends in /z/.

questions.question: How does the ending of watches sound?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: watches ends in /ɪz/.

narration.text:
play → plays · run → runs。<#0.8#>每天的习惯，你说 主语换成第三人称单数时，动词要留下一个小标记。<#0.8#>这个 -s 不是复数，而是一般现在时里，主语为 he、she、it 或一个人事物时的动词标记，叫第三人称单数形式。<#0.8#>
大多数动词直接加 s，play 变 plays，run 变 runs。<#0.6#>watch、wash、fix、go 这类结尾，为了读起来顺口，通常加 es：watches、washes、fixes、goes。辅音字母加 y 结尾的 study，要把 y 变 i 再加 es，成为 studies；have 则直接变 has。<#0.8#>
拼对了还要听读音。likes 的词尾读 /s/，plays 和 runs 读 /z/，watches 读 /iz/，多出一个音节。不用先背一长串术语，可以用嘴巴感受：前面已经是 s、sh、ch 这类嘶声，就需要 /iz/ 把词尾送出来。实际做题先确认是一般现在时和三单主语，再看动词结尾决定 s、es 或 ies，最后读一遍检查发音。

course.title: Past and past-participle forms
examples: go → went → gone · see → saw → seen

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Normally add -ed; after e add only -d.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Consonant+y changes to ied; a final consonant doubles in the stressed CVC pattern.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Learn irregular past and participle forms separately.

rules: Regular past forms add -ed, or only -d after final e.
Consonant+y changes to -ied; eligible stressed CVC verbs double the final consonant.
Irregular verbs do not take -ed; learn past and participle separately.

questions.question: What is the past form of live?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Add d after final e.

questions.question: What is the past form of stop?
questions.correct: Double p in this stressed CVC verb.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Double p in this stressed CVC verb.

questions.question: What is the past participle of go?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: gone is the past participle.

narration.text:
work → worked · live → lived。<#0.8#>要讲昨天的事，work 通常要穿上 -ed，变成 worked。<#0.8#>大多数规则动词就这样表示过去；如果原词已经有 e，live 只加 d，成为 lived，不会写成 liveed。<#0.8#>
有些词在加 -ed 前要整理一下词尾。<#0.6#>study 的 y 前是辅音字母，所以变成 studied。stop 只有一个重读音节，末尾是“辅音、元音、辅音”的紧结构，要双写 p，成为 stopped。但 open 的重音不在最后，通常不双写。<#0.8#>
更需要小心的是 go 和 see。go 的过去式是 went，过去分词是 gone；see 是 saw 和 seen。过去式可以自己做谓语，过去分词常跟 have 或 be 组合，两者不能因为都和过去有关就混用。实际书写时，先判断动词是否规则；规则动词再检查 e、辅音加 y 和重读闭音节；不规则动词则要把“原形、过去式、过去分词”成组调出来。

course.title: Subject–verb agreement
examples: The boy with his friends plays football.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The head subject boy is third-person singular, so the verb is plays.

exampleNotes.title: Word order
exampleNotes.body: with his friends modifies boy and does not change the singular head.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Tom and Jack form a plural coordinated subject, so the verb is play.

rules: In the present simple, a third-person singular subject takes a third-singular verb.
A postmodifying prepositional phrase does not change the number of the head subject.
Two subjects joined by and normally take a plural verb.

questions.question: Mary ___ every day.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Mary is third-person singular.

questions.question: The girl with two dogs ___ here.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The singular head is girl.

questions.question: Tom and Jack ___ here.
questions.correct: The coordinated subject takes a plural verb.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The coordinated subject takes a plural verb.

narration.text:
一群人踢球和一个男孩踢球，动作一样，但一般现在时的动词要和真正的主角对上号。The boy plays football 里，the boy 是一个人，所以 play 变 plays。<#0.8#>
再看 The boy with his friends plays football。<#0.8#>动词前最近的 friends 是复数，但这句的核心主角仍然是 the boy。with his friends 只补充他和谁一起，不会把主角变成多数。因此仍然用 plays。这种谓语形式跟主语人称和单复数配合的关系，叫主谓一致。<#0.8#>
Tom and Jack play football 则不同。<#0.7#>and 把 Tom 和 Jack 都放进主语，现在是两个人，所以用 play。最常见的错误是只盯着动词前最近的名词。判断时，先框出完整主语，再找它的中心；把 with、of、together with 后的补充暂时遮住；最后看中心是单数，还是由 and 真正连成复数。先找谁在掌控谓语，再选动词形式。

course.title: Present simple
examples: She walks to school every day.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: boils states a general fact, not an action limited to this moment.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: every day marks a habit, and She changes walk to walks.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Does carries the question and agreement marking, so like returns to the base form.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: leaves uses the present simple for a fixed timetable.

rules: The present simple expresses facts, states and habitual actions.
A third-person singular affirmative changes the lexical verb form.
Questions and negatives with lexical verbs use do/does plus the base form.
A fixed timetable can use the present simple for a future event.

questions.question: The sun ___ in the east.
questions.correct: Use present simple for a fact.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use present simple for a fact.

questions.question: She ___ English every day.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use studies with third-person singular.

questions.question: ___ he play chess?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use Does + base verb.

questions.question: The film ___ at eight tonight.
questions.correct: A fixed timetable can use starts.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: A fixed timetable can use starts.

narration.text:
水在一百摄氏度沸腾，不是只在你说话的这一秒发生。Water boils at 100 degrees。<#0.8#>这句把事情当作稳定事实来说。She walks to school every day 则是反复出现的习惯。这种说事实、状态和常规习惯的视角，叫一般现在时。<#0.8#>
主语是 he、she、it 或一个人事物时，肯定句的实义动词要用三单，所以是 She walks。<#0.7#>但变疑问时要说 Does he like music？Does 已经拿走三单标记，后面用 like，不是 likes。否定句 它的否定形式 也是同一道理。<#0.8#>
The train leaves at seven 看似未来，却仍用一般现在时，因为列车时刻表是既定安排，说话人把它当作稳定事实。判断时不要只找 every day。先问说话人是否把内容当成稳定状态、反复习惯或固定时刻表；再看主语决定动词原形还是三单；有 do 或 does 时，实义动词恢复原形。

course.title: Present progressive
examples: I am staying with my aunt this week.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: is sleeping shows an action in progress now.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: am staying describes a temporary situation during this week.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: is getting highlights a change that is developing now.

rules: The present progressive uses am/is/are + doing for action in progress now.
It can also express a temporary situation around now.
Progressive get/become can highlight an ongoing change.

questions.question: Look! It ___.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Look signals action in progress.

questions.question: This month I ___ by bus.
questions.correct: this month marks a temporary situation.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: this month marks a temporary situation.

questions.question: Days ___ longer.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The progressive highlights change.

narration.text:
现在看一眼宝宝，他正在睡觉。The baby is sleeping now。<#0.8#>这句不是说宝宝平时有睡觉的习惯，而是把镜头对准此刻正在展开的过程。is 负责现在时和主语配合，sleeping 展示动作正在进行，合起来就是现在进行时。<#0.8#>
这个镜头不一定只有一秒。<#0.6#>I am staying with my aunt this week 表示这一周的临时安排，说话时我可能正在学校，但这个阶段仍在持续。The weather is getting warmer 则把气温越来越高的变化展开给我们看。<#0.8#>
结构是 am、is 或 are，加动词的 -ing 形式，两部分都不能丢。只写 只保留宝宝和 sleeping 还没有为这个小句装上现在时。判断时，先问是否在拍一个此刻或当前阶段的动态镜头，还是在陈述稳定习惯；如果是动态镜头，再按主语选 am、is、are，并检查后面是否用 doing。

course.title: Past simple
examples: She did not see him yesterday.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: visited places the completed visit in last year.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: did not marks past time and negation, so see stays in the base form.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Did carries past time at the front, so finish returns to the base form.

rules: The past simple expresses a completed past action or state.
A lexical-verb negative uses did not + base form.
A lexical-verb question uses Did + subject + base form.

questions.question: Last night we ___ a film.
questions.correct: Use the past form with a definite past time.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use the past form with a definite past time.

questions.question: She did not ___ home.
questions.correct: Use the base form after did.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use the base form after did.

questions.question: ___ he call you?
questions.correct: Use Did for this lexical-verb past question.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use Did for this lexical-verb past question.

narration.text:
相册里有一张去年苏州的照片。We visited Suzhou last year。<#0.8#>这次旅行放在已经结束的过去时间里，说话人不是在强调它和现在的连接。visited 用过去式把整件事放回了过去，这叫一般过去时。<#0.8#>
否定时，过去的标记会移到 did 上。<#0.6#>She did not see him yesterday 里，did 已经表示过去，所以后面是 see，不是 saw。疑问句 Did you finish the work 也一样，Did 放到主语前，finish 恢复原形。一句里不需要 did 和过去式同时重复标记过去。<#0.8#>
常见的 last year、yesterday、几天前 能帮助定位，但不是只要看到它们就不思考。判断时，先画一条时间线，看事情是否完全落在已结束的过去区间；肯定句用动词过去式；有 did 的否定或疑问句，实义动词立即回到原形。

course.title: Future forms
course.meta: will · be going to · arranged future
examples: Look at the clouds; it is going to rain.
We are meeting the teacher tomorrow.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: will call expresses a promise or decision made at speaking time.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The clouds are present evidence, so is going to predicts rain.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: are meeting expresses an arranged near-future event.

rules: will + base form can express instant decisions, predictions and promises.
be going to expresses a prior plan or an evidence-based prediction.
The present progressive can express an arranged near future.

questions.question: I think it ___ fine tomorrow.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use will for a prediction.

questions.question: Look at those clouds! It ___.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Present evidence supports going to.

questions.question: We ___ the doctor at 3 p.m. tomorrow.
questions.correct: Use present progressive for an arrangement.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use present progressive for an arrangement.

narration.text:
电话响了，你当场决定“我今晚给你回电话”，可以说 I will call you tonight。<#0.8#>will 常把临时决定、承诺或当下的预测指向未来，后面用动词原形。<#0.8#>
抬头看见乌云已经压下来，你说 It is going to rain。<#0.7#>这不是凭空猜测，而是根据眼前迹象判断。going to 结构 也可以表示已经有的计划。注意 be 要按主语变成 am、is 或 are。<#0.8#>
如果时间和对方都已经安排好，会说 We are meeting the teacher tomorrow。现在进行时放在这里，不是说此刻正在见老师，而是把未来会面当作已排进日程的事。选择时，先问决定是否刚刚做出，是就用 will；再看是否有早已存在的计划或眼前迹象，可用 going to 结构；如果具体安排已落定，就考虑现在进行时。不要只看 tomorrow，要看未来是怎样被说话人想象的。

course.title: Verbs and the five basic patterns
examples: I like music. (SVO) · Mum gave me a gift. (SVOO)

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Intransitive verbs form SV; linking verbs form SVC.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Transitive verbs may take one or two objects.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: The object complement describes the object.

rules: SVC contains a linking verb and subject complement.
SVO has one object; SVOO has two.
In SVOC, the complement predicates something of the object.

questions.question: “Birds sing” is ...
questions.wrong: Check the rule: sing has no object.

questions.question: “She gave me a pen” is ...
questions.wrong: Check the rule: There are two objects.

questions.question: “We kept the room clean” is ...
questions.wrong: Check the rule: clean complements room.

narration.text:
Birds fly. (SV) · She is kind. (SVC)。<#0.8#>动词像游戏里不同形状的插槽，有的自己就能完成画面，有的后面必须接一块或两块内容。Birds fly 说完已经成立，只有主语和谓语，叫 SV。<#0.8#>
She is kind 里，is 把 She 和 kind 连起来，kind 说明她怎样，这是 SVC，也就是主系表。<#0.7#>I like music 的 like 直接需要“喜欢什么”，music 是宾语，这是 SVO。Mum gave me a gift 有接收者 me 和东西 a gift，这是 SVOO。<#0.8#>
They made me happy 最容易混。me 是被影响的人，happy 说明 me 最后的状态，两者能连成“我很开心”，所以 happy 是宾补，整体是 SVOC。判句型先找动词，再问它后面必须补“主语怎样”、一个对象、接收者加东西，还是对宾语的说明。暂时去掉时间地点，留下的必需插槽就决定句型。

course.title: Be, do and have as auxiliaries

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: are does not name the action; with working it forms the progressive.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Do helps know form a question, and know stays in the base form.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: has and finished together show a completed action relevant now.

rules: be + doing forms the progressive; be + done the passive.
do/does/did supplies questions, negatives and emphasis in simple tenses.
have/has/had + participle forms the perfect.

questions.question: What does are do here?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: are + playing forms the progressive.

questions.question: ___ she like it?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use Does.

questions.question: What does has do here?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: has + left forms the perfect.

narration.text:
be、do、have 单独出现时有自己的意思，但它们也常做幕后助手，帮主要动词搭出不同结构。They are working 里，are 没有表示“是”，它和 working 组合，把动作展示为正在进行。<#0.8#>
当门被关上时 里，be 加过去分词 closed，让门成为动作承受者，这是被动。<#0.7#>Do you know him 里，know 本身没有可以移到主语前的助手，所以 do 来帮它变疑问。否定句 实义动词的否定形式 也靠 do 安放 not。<#0.8#>
She has finished the task 里，has 加过去分词 finished，把任务的完成和现在连起来，这是完成体。判断这三个词的工作，不要只看词形。先看它后面跟的是 doing、done 还是动词原形；be 加 doing 表进行，be 加 done 表被动，have 加 done 表完成，do 则常帮一般时实义动词做疑问、否定或强调。

course.title: Core modal meanings

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: can/could express ability or permission.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: They express different force or source of obligation/advice.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: They express degrees of possibility and deduction.

rules: can/could express ability or permission and take a base verb.
must, have to and should express obligation, necessity or advice.
may/might, must and can’t express degrees of deduction.

questions.question: ___ I use your phone?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: May asks permission.

questions.question: You look tired. You ___ rest.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: should gives advice.

questions.question: The light is on. He ___ be home.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: must marks strong deduction.

narration.text:
can/could: ability or permission。<#0.8#>同一个“去”，前面加不同小词，说话人的态度就变了。can 放在动词前 可能是你有能力去，也可能是你被允许去。must 放在动词前 则带着强烈必要性。<#0.8#>
can 和 could 常说能力或请求允许，could 用在请求中通常更委婉。<#0.7#>must 可以表说话人认为必须，have to 常突出外部规定或客观需要，should 更像建议。这些词叫情态动词或情态表达，核心是把说话人的判断加到动作上。<#0.8#>
它们还能表推测。may 表示可能 是可能在家；must 表示肯定推测 不是命令他在家，而是根据线索推断“他肯定在”；can't 表示不可能 表示“不可能在”。判断时，先看语境在说能力、允许、义务、建议还是推测，再根据态度强弱选词。最后检查：can、must、may、should 后面用动词原形，不加 to，也不变三单。

course.title: Present perfect versus past simple

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: have visited counts experience up to now without a finished past time.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: since 2020 connects the living from the past to now, so has lived is used.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: last year is a finished past time, so visited is used.

rules: The present perfect expresses experience up to now or a present result.
With since/for, use a durative expression for continuation to now.
A definite finished past time normally takes past simple.

questions.question: I ___ this film twice.
questions.correct: twice marks experience up to now.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: twice marks experience up to now.

questions.question: He ___ here for five years.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use durative live.

questions.question: She ___ yesterday.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: yesterday requires past simple.

narration.text:
你说 I have visited Beijing twice，重点是到现在为止有过两次北京经历，并没有把它钉在某一个已结束的时间。<#0.8#>这种把过去的事与现在经验或结果连起来的说法，用 have 或 has 加过去分词，叫现在完成时。<#0.8#>
She has lived here since 2020 中，since 给出起点，居住从二零二零年一直延伸到现在。<#0.7#>for 则给出延续多久。如果这种延续还没有结束，要选能持续的动词表达，不能用瞬间动作硬拉一段时间。<#0.8#>
We visited Beijing last year 则把旅行放在已经结束的 last year，所以用一般过去时。两者的分界不是“事情发生过没有”，而是说话人是否把镜头连到现在。判断时，先找 yesterday、last year 这类已结束时间，有就优先考虑一般过去时；没有时，再问是否在说截至现在的经历、结果或延续。

course.title: Passive voice across tenses
examples: is made · was made · will be made
is being repaired · was being repaired
has been finished · had been finished

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Simple passives change the tense of be.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: A progressive passive uses be + being + done.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: A perfect passive uses have + been + done.

rules: A simple passive uses the relevant form of be + participle.
A progressive passive uses be + being + participle.
A perfect passive uses have/has/had + been + participle.

questions.question: The room ___ every day.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use is cleaned.

questions.question: The road ___ now.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use the progressive passive.

questions.question: The work ___ already.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use has been + participle.

narration.text:
is made · was made · will be made。<#0.8#>工厂介绍一件产品时，往往更关心“它是怎么被制造的”，而不是谁在操作。它在这里被制造 用 is 加过去分词 made，把承受动作的 it 放在主语位置，这是现在时被动。<#0.8#>
时间变化时，主要变的是 be。<#0.7#>was made 是过去制造，will be made 是将被制造。如果镜头正对着维修过程，要说 桥正在被修理，be 加 being 加过去分词，这是进行时被动。<#0.8#>
如果重点是已经完成，可以说 任务已经被完成。has 负责现在完成，been 建立被动，finished 表示具体动作。不要看到三个动词形式就分成三个谓语，它们是一条链。判断时，先确认主语是动作承受者，再确定一般、进行还是完成；最后按顺序搭骨架：一般被动用 be done，进行被动用 进行被动结构，完成被动用 完成被动结构。

course.title: Present tense in future clauses
examples: If it rains we will stay home.
I will call you when I arrive.
Even if he is busy he will help.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: will stay marks the future result, while rains states the condition.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The main clause uses will call; the future time clause still uses arrive.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The even if clause uses is for the future concession without will.

rules: In a real future condition, the if-clause uses present simple.
Future time clauses with when/as soon as/until use present simple.
Future concession clauses with even if normally avoid will.

questions.question: If it ___, we will leave.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use present simple.

questions.question: I will tell her when she ___.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use present simple.

questions.question: Even if he ___ busy, he will come.
questions.correct: Avoid will in the concession clause.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Avoid will in the concession clause.

narration.text:
明天是否下雨还没确定，但你可以说 If it rains, we will stay home。<#0.8#>两部分都谈未来，英语却不在 if 后再放 will。if 已经把 rains 标成未来条件，主句 will stay 再说条件成立后的结果。<#0.8#>
时间从句也是同样。<#0.6#>I will call you when I arrive 里，arrive 形式上是一般现在时，意思却由 when 指向未来到达的那一刻。表示“一……就……”的连接词、before、after、until 引出的未来时间从句，通常也这样处理。<#0.8#>
Even if he is busy, he will help 表示即使将来忙，也会帮忙。even if 引出让步条件，从句仍用 is，不用 will be。这个简称“主将从现”，但不能看到从句就套。判断时，先确认 if、when、until、even if 引出的是真实未来条件、时间或让步；是的话，从句用一般现在时表未来，will 通常留在主句。

course.title: The infinitive
examples: I need a pen to write with.
She got up early to catch the bus.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: To learn English is one subject, so takes is singular.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: to write with postmodifies pen; pen supplies the understood object of with.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: to catch the bus answers why she got up early, so it marks purpose.

rules: An infinitive can be subject, object or complement.
An infinitive can postmodify a noun or pronoun.
An infinitive commonly marks purpose and can mark result or cause.

questions.question: ___ a language takes time.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: An infinitive can be subject.

questions.question: I need something ___.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The infinitive postmodifies something.

questions.question: He went out ___ milk.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The infinitive marks purpose.

narration.text:
说“学英语需要时间”，英语可以把动作“学”打包成一件事：To learn English takes time。<#0.8#>To learn English 整块站在主语位置，takes 才是负责时间的谓语。to 加动词原形叫不定式，它有动作意思，却能整体去做别的句子工作。<#0.8#>
I need a pen to write with 里，to write with 说明需要一支什么用途的笔，它放在 pen 后面修饰 pen。<#0.7#>介词 with 不能丢，因为普通关系是 用笔书写这层关系。She got up early to catch the bus 里，to catch the bus 回答“为什么早起”，表示目的。<#0.8#>
不定式也能放在动词后补充“想做、决定做”的内容，但不能因为中文有“去做”就乱加 to。判断时，先找整句真正承担时间的谓语，再把 to do 整块圈出来；问它在表示一件事、修饰前面名词，还是回答目的。先找整块的工作，再确定术语。

course.title: The gerund

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Reading treats the action as an activity and serves as subject.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: enjoys needs an object, and the gerund dancing fills that position.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: without is a preposition, so saying goodbye is its gerund object.

rules: A gerund can act as subject or complement.
enjoy, finish, mind, avoid and practice take doing.
A preposition takes doing, not an infinitive; this includes prepositional to.

questions.question: ___ is useful.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: A gerund can be subject.

questions.question: She enjoys ___.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: enjoy takes doing.

questions.question: He left without ___.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use doing after a preposition.

narration.text:
Reading helps us 不是一句缺少主语的命令。<#0.8#>Reading 在这里表示“阅读这件事”，整体站在主语位置，helps 才是谓语。动词加 -ing 后保留动作意思，同时像名词一样做主语、宾语或表语，这种用法叫动名词。<#0.8#>
She enjoys dancing 里，dancing 是 enjoys 的宾语，表示她享受跳舞这项活动。<#0.7#>enjoy、finish、mind、avoid、practice 后常选 doing，这是动词自己选择的补足方式，不能只把中文“做”换成任意形式。<#0.8#>
He left without saying goodbye 里，without 是介词，介词后面要放能当名词性内容的 saying goodbye，不用 to say。即使介词本身是 to，如 表示期待的介词结构，后面也用 doing。判断时，先看 -ing 整块是否在句中代表一项活动；再看它是主语、动词宾语还是介词宾语。若前面是介词，直接优先检查 doing。

course.title: Spelling the -ing form

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Most verbs add -ing directly.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Normally drop silent e; double the final consonant in an eligible stressed CVC verb.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Change final -ie to y before -ing.

rules: Most verbs add -ing directly.
Normally drop silent e; eligible stressed CVC verbs double the final consonant.
Change final -ie to y before adding -ing.

questions.question: What is the -ing form of work?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Add ing directly.

questions.question: What is the -ing form of run?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Double n before ing.

questions.question: What is the -ing form of lie?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Change ie to y.

narration.text:
work → working · play → playing。<#0.8#>给动词加 -ing 时，大多数很直接：work 变 working，play 变 playing。<#0.8#>但有些词尾如果原样保留，会让拼写和发音不匹配，所以加之前要做一个小调整。<#0.8#>
write 末尾的 e 不发音，加 -ing 时去掉 e，成为 writing。<#0.7#>run 只有一个重读音节，词尾是紧的“辅音、元音、辅音”结构，要双写 n，成为 running。这样能保住原来的短元音。open 的重音不在末音节，通常不双写。<#0.8#>
lie 和 die 又是另一类，末尾 ie 先变成 y，再加 ing，得到 lying 和 dying，不写 lieing。实际拼写可以用四步：先看是否为 ie 结尾，是就变 y；再看是否有不发音 e，有就通常去掉；然后检查末音节是否重读且需要双写；都不是，就直接加 -ing。

course.title: Phrasal verbs and object position
examples: turn on the light → turn the light on
turn it on ✓ · turn on it ✗

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: A noun object may go between or after a separable phrasal verb.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: A pronoun object must go between the verb and particle.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Prepositional verbs are normally inseparable.

rules: Learn a phrasal verb as a meaning unit and note whether it is separable.
Pronoun placement is a key test of separable phrasal verbs.

questions.question: Please turn ___ on.
questions.correct: Put the pronoun between turn and on.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Put the pronoun between turn and on.

questions.question: She looks ___ her sister.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: look after is inseparable.

questions.question: Which correctly replaces “the box” with a pronoun?
questions.correct: The pronoun must go in the middle.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The pronoun must go in the middle.

narration.text:
老师说 turn on the light，turn 不是让你转身，turn on 合在一起才是“打开”。<#0.8#>动词和后面的小词组成一个新意思，这种组合常叫短语动词。学它时不能只背 turn 和 on 的单独中文，要连同宾语位置一起学。<#0.8#>
turn on 在这个意思下可以拆开，所以 turn on the light 和 turn the light on 都可以。<#0.7#>但宾语换成 it 时，只能说 turn it on，不说 turn on it。短小代词必须放在动词和小品词中间，这是可分短语动词的高频位置。<#0.8#>
look after the child 却不能把 the child 塞进 look 和 after 中间，因为 after 在这里带着自己的介词宾语，这种组合不可分。判断时，先确认两个词是否共同形成一个意思；再查这个组合是否可分；最后把宾语换成 it 测一次。如果是可分结构，it 必须放中间。

course.title: Active and passive voice
examples: The letter was written by Tom.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The active sentence makes the agent Tom subject and the letter object.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The passive makes the letter subject and uses was written to show it receives the action.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The focus is where English is spoken; the agent is unimportant and omitted.

rules: The passive uses be + past participle; the active object becomes subject.
Omit the by-phrase when the agent is unknown or unimportant.

questions.question: The bridge ___ in 2010.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The passive needs was built.

questions.question: What is the passive form of “People speak English”?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: English receives the action.

questions.question: What structure is used in “The window was broken”?
questions.correct: was + past participle forms the passive.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: was + past participle forms the passive.

narration.text:
桌上有一封信，可以先说写信人：Tom wrote the letter。<#0.8#>也可以把镜头转向信：The letter was written by Tom。事情没变，只是被关注的参与者换了。第一句由做动作的人做主语，叫主动语态；第二句由承受动作的 letter 做主语，叫被动语态。<#0.8#>
被动骨架是 be 加过去分词。was 负责过去时，written 说明 letter 承受 write 的动作。<#0.7#>by Tom 只在需要交代写信者时出现。English is spoken worldwide 里，具体谁说不重要，所以不用 by people。<#0.8#>
改被动时，先找主动句中承受动作的宾语，把它放到主语位置；再保留原来时间，选对 be 的形式；然后把实义动词变过去分词。最后问施动者是否未知、不重要或已明显，是的话省掉 by 短语。

course.title: Tense and aspect
course.meta: Time and the state of an action

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: study with every day presents the action as a repeated habit.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: am studying with now presents the action as in progress.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: have finished links past completion with the present result.

rules: Simple forms express habits or facts, progressive forms ongoing actions, and perfect forms a past-to-present result.
Time markers help, but meaning decides the tense.

questions.question: Look! The dog ___.
questions.correct: Look signals an action in progress.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Look signals an action in progress.

questions.question: She ___ here since 2020.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: since links past and present.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use present simple for facts.

narration.text:
同一个“学英语”，可以选三种镜头。I study English every day 把它当日常习惯；I am studying now 把此刻过程放大；I have finished my homework 把过去完成的事连到现在结果。<#0.8#>这说明时态不只标“过去、现在、未来”，还展示说话人如何看动作。<#0.8#>
一般体常把事当作事实或完整事件，进行体展示过程，完成体建立较早动作与当前参照点的连接。<#0.7#>now、every day、already 只是线索，不是按下就必然得出某时态的按钮。<#0.8#>
判断时先定位参照时间，再问想展示稳定事实、正在进行的过程，还是已完成且与参照点有关的结果。最后才用时间标志检查。先选镜头，再选结构，比只背标志词更稳，也更能解释真实句子。

course.title: Non-finite verb basics

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: wants is finite; to leave depends on it and is not another finite predicate.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Swimming turns the action into a subject; is is the finite predicate.

exampleNotes.title: Word order
exampleNotes.body: broken modifies window before the noun here.

rules: A non-finite verb cannot serve alone as the finite predicate.
to do often suggests purpose or prospect; doing has nominal/progressive force; done often suggests passive/completed meaning.

questions.question: I hope ___ you.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: hope commonly takes to do.

questions.question: ___ is fun.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Reading can act as subject.

questions.question: the ___ door
questions.wrong: Check the rule: closed is a participial modifier.

narration.text:
She wants to leave 里有两个动作意思，但只有 wants 会随主语和时间变化，to leave 只把“离开”打包成她想做的事。<#0.8#>Swimming is good exercise 里，Swimming 表示一项活动，is 才负责时间。The broken window 里，broken 说明 window 承受了破坏。<#0.8#>
这些保留动作意思，却不独立让小句获得时态和主谓一致的形式，叫非谓语。<#0.7#>to do 常把动作看成目标、目的或未展开的事；doing 常把它看成活动或进行画面；done 常带被动或完成视角。<#0.8#>
判断时，先找每个小句中真正承担时间的谓语；再圈出剩下的 to do、doing、done；最后问它整体在句中做主语、宾语、修饰语还是目的说明。这一节只负责分清谓语和非谓语边界，后面再分别学三种形式。

course.title: Past progressive
course.meta: Action in progress at a past time
examples: I was reading at eight last night.
They were playing when it began to rain.
While Mum was cooking Dad was cleaning

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: was reading shows the action in progress at eight last night.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: were playing is the ongoing background; began is the shorter interrupting event.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: while links two continuing past actions happening at the same time.

rules: The past progressive uses was/were + doing for action in progress at a past time.
when often introduces a shorter event interrupting an ongoing background action.
while often links simultaneous continuing actions.

questions.question: At nine yesterday I ___.
questions.correct: Use past progressive for action in progress then.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use past progressive for action in progress then.

questions.question: I was walking when he ___.
questions.correct: The interrupting event uses past simple.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The interrupting event uses past simple.

questions.question: While I was reading, she ___.
questions.correct: Use past progressive for simultaneous continuing action.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use past progressive for simultaneous continuing action.

narration.text:
昨晚八点，你像把摄像机放回过去：I was reading at eight last night。<#0.8#>was 把镜头定位在过去，reading 展示当时尚未结束的过程。was 或 were 加 doing，叫过去进行时。<#0.8#>
They were playing when it began to rain 里，玩耍是正在展开的背景，下雨是途中发生的较短事件。<#0.7#>when 常把短事件插入持续背景，但不是见到 when 就必须一进行一过去，还要看动作长短。<#0.8#>
While Mum was cooking, Dad was cleaning 像分屏画面，两个持续动作同时进行。判断时，先找过去参照点，再问那一刻动作是否正在中途；若有两个动作，还要看是背景与插入事件，还是两个同时持续的画面。

course.title: Past perfect, future-in-the-past and sequence
examples: The train had left before we arrived.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: had left occurred before arrived: the train left first.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: said is past, and would return is future viewed from that past point.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: was tired shifts the state into the past viewpoint set by said.

rules: Past perfect had + done expresses an earlier past.
would + base expresses future viewed from the past.
An object clause after past reporting normally shifts to a past viewpoint; universal truths are excepted.

questions.question: By then the film ___.
questions.correct: Use past perfect for the earlier event.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use past perfect for the earlier event.

questions.question: He said he ___ come.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use would.

questions.question: She said she ___ ill.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Shift to the past viewpoint.

narration.text:
到车站时，火车已经开走：The train had left before we arrived。<#0.8#>到达是过去参照点，had left 把开走放在它之前，所以叫“过去的过去”，结构是 had 加过去分词。<#0.8#>
He said he would return 中，said 把观察点带回过去，对当时的他来说，“回来”还在未来，所以用 would 加原形。<#0.7#>She said she was tired 里，疲惫与过去说话情境对应，所以 is 后移为 was。<#0.8#>
但转述仍成立的客观真理，不必机械后移。做题先标出过去参照点；早于它的动作考虑 had done，晚于它的过去未来考虑 would do；转述内容则问是否要保持过去视角。先排清事件先后，再选时态，不要只看某一个时间词。

course.title: Present and past participles
examples: The book written by Lu Xun is famous.

analyses.text: The book written by Lu Xun
analyses.label: Past-participle postmodifier

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: crying shows that the baby actively produces the ongoing action.

exampleNotes.title: Word order
exampleNotes.body: The postmodifier moves before the noun in Chinese.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: she is the understood subject of Walking home; she saw Tom on the way home.

rules: An -ing participle normally carries active or ongoing meaning.
A past participle normally carries passive or completed meaning.
A participial phrase can modify a noun or clause; an adverbial participle normally shares the main subject.

questions.question: the ___ girl
questions.correct: Use smiling for the active relation.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use smiling for the active relation.

questions.question: the letter ___ yesterday
questions.correct: Use written for a passive completed relation.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use written for a passive completed relation.

questions.question: ___ home, I met Tom.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: I is the understood subject.

narration.text:
The crying baby 里，宝宝正在哭，crying 和 baby 是主动关系，带着进行画面。<#0.8#>The book written by Lu Xun 里，书是 write 的承受者，written 带着被动和完成视角。doing 和 done 这样修饰名词或补充画面时，叫分词。<#0.8#>
written by Lu Xun 整块后置修饰 book，中文理解时通常前移成“鲁迅写的书”。<#0.7#>Walking home, she saw Tom 里，Walking home 不修饰某个名词，而是给整个主句补充背景。<#0.8#>
这时要问“谁在 walking”，答案必须能和主句主语 she 对上。判断时，先找分词所指的名词或逻辑主语；再问它们是主动还是被动、动作正展开还是已完成；主动进行倾向 doing，被动完成倾向 done。

course.title: Causative and perception verbs
examples: I saw him cross the road.
I saw him crossing the road.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: us is the object of made, and laugh predicates the action of us.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: cross uses the base form to present the complete event seen.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: crossing focuses on the action in progress at the moment of seeing.

rules: make/let take object + base; passive make restores to.
Perception verb + object + base emphasizes a complete event.
Perception verb + object + doing emphasizes action in progress.

questions.question: The teacher made us ___.
questions.correct: Active make takes a base verb.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Active make takes a base verb.

questions.question: I saw him ___ and leave.
questions.correct: Use the base for the complete event.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use the base for the complete event.

questions.question: I saw him ___ when I arrived.
questions.correct: Use doing for action in progress.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use doing for action in progress.

narration.text:
The joke made us laugh 表示笑话让我们笑。<#0.8#>made 的对象是 us，laugh 说明 us 做了什么。主动句里，make 和 let 后用“宾语加动词原形”，不加 to。但改成 改成被动后 时，to 要恢复。<#0.8#>
I saw him cross the road 把过马路当作从开始到结束的完整事件，所以用原形 cross。<#0.7#>I saw him crossing the road 只拍到他当时正在过，不说明是否看到全过程，所以用 crossing。这两种都是宾语加宾语补足语。<#0.8#>
判断时，先找 make、let、see、hear、watch 后的宾语，再问后一个动作是谁做的。若表“使让”或感知到完整过程，用原形；若镜头只落在正进行的片段，用 doing。最后检查 make 是否改被动，是的话补回 to。

course.title: Meaning changes with doing and to do

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Recall a past action ↔ remember a duty.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: End the action ↔ pause to do another.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Test a method ↔ make an effort.

rules: remember/forget doing recalls a past action; to do concerns a duty.
stop doing ends the action; stop to do pauses for another.
try doing tests a method; try to do makes an effort.

questions.question: Remember the duty to turn off the light.
questions.correct: Use to do for a duty.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use to do for a duty.

questions.question: He ended the activity of smoking.
questions.correct: Use doing to end the activity.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use doing to end the activity.

questions.question: Test restarting as a method.
questions.correct: Use doing to test a method.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use doing to test a method.

narration.text:
形式相近，意义不同：remember doing ↔ remember to do。<#0.8#>出门前想起“还要关灯”，说 remember to do；回家后回想“我记得关过了”，说 remember doing。<#0.8#>to do 指向当时未完成的任务，doing 指向已发生、可回想的事。<#0.8#>
stop doing 是停止抽烟；stop to do 是停下原来的事，目的是抽烟。<#0.7#>doing 是被停止的事，to do 是停下后要做的新事。try doing 是试试重启这个办法；try to do 是努力把它重启成功。<#0.8#>
判断时不只背“某词后接 doing 或 to do”。先问动作已发生还是待完成，是原来的事还是新目的，是试验办法还是努力完成。把两个动作的先后和关系说清，再选 doing 或 to do。

course.title: Passive and perfect non-finite forms
course.meta: to be done · being done · having done
examples: Having finished the work, she left.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Passive non-finite forms retain a passive relation.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Perfect forms mark action prior to the finite verb.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: she is the understood subject of both actions.

rules: to be done/being done marks a passive relation.
to have done/having done marks prior action.
The understood subject must be clear; an adverbial participle normally shares the main subject.

questions.question: He hopes ___. (passive)
questions.wrong: Check the rule: He receives the action.

questions.question: She seems ___ it.
questions.correct: The perfect form marks prior action.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The perfect form marks prior action.

questions.question: ___ the work, she left.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: she is the shared subject.

narration.text:
他希望被邀请，要说 他希望被邀请。<#0.8#>to be invited 保留不定式，同时用 be 加过去分词表被动。being praised 也是被动，但用 doing 形式把被表扬当作一项活动或进行画面。<#0.8#>
她似乎已经完成 里，看起来是现在判断，完成任务却早于它，所以用 不定式完成式 表示非谓语动作先发生。<#0.7#>Having finished the work, she left 也把完成工作放在离开之前。<#0.8#>
最后要问“谁在做”。Having finished 的执行者必须是主句主语 she。判断时，先看逻辑主语是执行者还是承受者，决定主动或被动；再比较非谓语与谓语动作的先后，明显早于谓语时考虑 不定式完成式 或 having done；最后检查逻辑主语是否清楚对应。

course.title: Complex subject–verb agreement
course.meta: Proximity · head noun · indefinites · subject structures
examples: Either Tom or his friends are coming.
Tom, together with his friends is here.
To read every day improves your English.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The nearer subject friends is plural, so the predicate is are coming.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: together with his friends is added information; Tom controls singular is.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Everyone takes singular agreement, so has is used.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Swimming names one activity, so the predicate is keeps.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: To read every day is one subject, so improves is singular.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: What he says is one subject clause and agrees with singular sounds.

rules: With either...or, neither...nor and not only...but also, agreement often follows the nearer subject.
with, together with and as well as do not change the head subject’s number.
everyone, each, either and neither normally take singular agreement.
A gerund phrase naming one activity normally takes singular agreement.
An infinitive phrase as subject is normally treated as one singular unit.
A subject clause is normally treated as one singular unit.

questions.question: Either Tom or the boys ___ ready.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The nearer subject is plural.

questions.question: Tom, with his friends, ___ here.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The head Tom is singular.

questions.question: Everyone ___ a book.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: everyone is singular.

questions.question: Reading books ___ her relax.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Reading books is one activity.

questions.question: To stay calm ___ practice.
questions.correct: The infinitive phrase is one subject.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The infinitive phrase is one subject.

questions.question: What he needs ___ more time.
questions.correct: The subject clause is one unit.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The subject clause is one unit.

narration.text:
Either Tom or his friends are coming 有两个候选主语，either...or 常让谓语和较近的一项配合，friends 是复数，所以用 are。<#0.8#>Tom, together with his friends, is here 里，together with his friends 只是陪同信息，真正中心仍是单数 Tom，所以用 is。<#0.8#>
Everyone has a ticket 里，everyone 意思包含每一个人，语法上却逐个看待，通常按单数用 has。<#0.7#>Swimming keeps us healthy、To read every day improves your English、What he says sounds true 的主语虽然很长，却各自把一项活动或一件事当成一个整体，通常用单数谓语。<#0.8#>
判断时，or 类成对连接看就近，with 类附加信息看前面中心；everyone、each 先按单数；遇到 doing、to do 或从句作主语，先问它是否整体表示一件事。先识别主语的组装方式，再决定单复数。

course.title: High-frequency special patterns
course.meta: used to · had better · would rather
examples: used to do · be used to doing
had better do · had better not do

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Former habit ↔ be accustomed to.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: had better takes a base; the negative is had better not do.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: would rather takes a base and may contrast with than.

rules: used to + base marks a former habit; be used to + doing means be accustomed to.
had better (not) + base gives strong advice.
would rather + base expresses preference, often with than.

questions.question: He ___ get up late, but now he rises early.
questions.correct: Use used to do for a former habit.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use used to do for a former habit.

questions.question: You had better ___ late.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use had better not + base.

questions.question: I would rather ___ home.

narration.text:
used to do · be used to doing。<#0.8#>过去常晚起，现在不这样，说 used to do。<#0.8#>used to 加原形表过去习惯已改变。be used to doing 却是他已习惯早起，这里 to 是介词，后面用 doing。<#0.8#>
朋友快迟到了，你说 had better do。<#0.7#>had better 表示带后果提醒的较强建议，后面用原形。否定说 had better not do，not 放 better 后，不加 to。<#0.8#>
would rather do than do 表示两个选择中更愿留家。would rather 后用原形，than 后与前面保持平行。判断时，把整个词组当信号：第一组区分过去习惯和现在已习惯，第二组表强建议，第三组表个人偏好。再检查后面是原形还是 doing。

narration.text:
She enjoys reading 里，enjoy 把 reading 这项活动当宾语，英语选 doing，不选 to read。<#0.8#>He decided to leave 里，decide 指向尚待实现的决定内容，选 to leave。这些叫动词的补足方式，是词义和语言习惯共同决定的。<#0.8#>
Mum gave me a gift 又不是 doing 或 to do 问题。<#0.7#>give 带出一次传递，me 是接收者，a gift 是传递的东西，所以可用“人加物”的双宾语，也可改成 把礼物给我。<#0.8#>
学动词不只记中文意思，要连同后面允许的结构一起记，例如 enjoy doing、decide 后接不定式、give 后接人和物。做题先问主动词还缺“一项活动”、“一个目标”，还是“接收者和东西”；再调出该动词允许的结构，检查整块是否真的补全了它的意思。

narration.text:
一句话像一小段视频，总得告诉我们“发生了什么”。有人跑，有人知道答案，汤尝起来很甜。负责把这些动作或状态说出来的词，叫动词。动词不一定是跑、跳这种看得见的动作，know、like、is 也在告诉我们一种状态。<#0.8#>
先听最短的一句。<#0.4#>Birds fly。<#0.8#>Birds 告诉我们谁，fly 告诉我们鸟做什么。把 fly 拿掉，只剩“鸟”，事情就没说完整。所以 fly 是这句话最关键的发动机，语法上叫谓语核心。把很多只鸟换成一只鸟，就要说。<#0.4#>一只鸟作主语时，fly 会变成 flies。<#0.7#>fly 变成 flies，说明这个核心会跟着主语和时间调整形式。<#0.8#>
再听。<#0.4#>I know the answer。<#0.7#>know 不是能看到的动作，却说明“我知道”。它后面的 the answer 补上“知道什么”。有些动词后面要接一个对象，有些不需要。<#0.7#>
The soup tastes good 里，tastes 也不是说“汤在品尝”，它像一座桥，把 the soup 和 good 连起来，说明汤的味道很好。这类词叫系动词。<#0.8#>
找动词时，先问这句话到底在说谁做了什么，或谁处在什么状态；再找会跟着主语、时间发生变化的那个核心；最后看它后面是否还缺“什么”或“怎么样”。这样比看到带动作意思的词就圈，更可靠。

narration.text:
想象你只听到“她打开了”，你多半会追问：打开了什么？有些动词说完后，后面必须跟一个对象，意思才完整；有些动词自己就能把事情说完。<#0.8#>
She opened the window。<#0.8#>opened 的动作直接落在 the window 上，the window 叫宾语。像 open 这样可以直接带宾语的用法，叫及物。再听 The baby cried。<#0.7#>宝宝哭了，意思已经完整，不需要再补“哭了什么”。这种不直接带宾语的用法，叫不及物。<#0.8#>
We arrived at noon 里，at noon 说明到达的时间。它前面有介词 at，整块是时间补充，不是 arrive 直接带的宾语。判断时，先把时间、地点等补充暂时拿掉，再问动词后是否还必须回答“谁或什么”。能直接接上这个答案是及物；意思已完整，或必须先加介词，就不是直接宾语。

narration.text:
闻一口花，你说 感官系动词例句。<#0.8#>这不是“花在闻甜味”，而是“花闻起来很香甜”。smells 没有把动作打到 sweet 上，它像一座桥，把 flower 和 sweet 连起来，sweet 在说明花的性质。<#0.8#>
再看 She is a doctor。<#0.7#>a doctor 告诉我们 She 是谁。The leaves turned yellow 里，yellow 告诉我们叶子变成什么样。这些放在桥后面、回头说明主语身份、性质或状态的内容，叫表语；be、sound、smell、feel、become、turn 等在这种用法里叫系动词。<#0.8#>
要注意，同一个动词也可能换工作。当 tasted 表示真正品尝时 里，tasted 是真正去品尝，the soup 是宾语；当 tastes 只连接汤和它的味道时 里，tastes 只把汤和 good 连起来。判断时，把动词后面的内容和主语连成“主语是或变得怎样”。如果意思成立，后面是在说明主语，通常就是系动词加表语。

exampleNotes.title: Example focus

A modal is followed by the base verb.

questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use Does for this present-simple question.

narration.text:
有时动作本身没变，说话人只是想加上“不”、“正在”、“必须”这些信息。英语会在主要动词前放一个帮手，让它负责结构或语气。<#0.8#>
She does not like coffee。<#0.8#>真正表示“喜欢”的是 like，does 帮它安放 not，同时承担现在时和三单信息。这种帮动词完成否定、疑问、时态或语态的词，叫助动词。They are working 里，are 帮 working 表示动作正在进行。<#0.8#>
You must finish today。<#0.7#>finish 是完成，must 把“必须”这种强烈态度加进来。这类表示能力、允许、义务、推测的帮手，叫情态动词。情态动词后的主要动词用原形，所以是 must finish，不是 must finishes。判断时，先找真正说动作的词，再看前面的词是在帮它搭结构，还是加入说话人的判断。两者要和主要动词一起看成完整谓语。

narration.text:
同一个“玩”，遇到不同的人和时间，样子会变。你说 I play，换成她就是 She plays，换到昨天又是 They played。这些变化不是装饰，而是在告诉我们“谁”和“什么时候”。<#0.8#>
主语从单数换成复数时 更明显。<#0.7#>主语从一个人变成多个人，be 从 is 变成 are。能承担时间，并在需要时跟主语人称和单复数配合的动词部分，叫限定动词。它让一组词真正成为一个有时间落点的小句。<#0.8#>
再看 She wants to leave。<#0.7#>换到过去时，wants 变成 wanted，to leave 仍然保持这个样子。所以这句只有 wants 负责时间和主语配合，to leave 只补充想做什么，不是第二个限定谓语。实际判断时，先把句子分成一个个小句，再尝试换主语或换到过去。找出承担变化的动词部分，每个小句通常只有一个这样的核心。

narration.text:
听到 Mum gave me a gift，脑中要出现一次传递：妈妈把礼物交到我手上。<#0.8#>给了什么？a gift。给了谁？me。动词后同时放着接收者和传递的东西，这叫双宾语。me 是间接宾语，a gift 是直接宾语。<#0.8#>
这句也可以说 Mum gave a gift to me。<#0.7#>这时 a gift 仍是直接宾语，to me 是介词短语，把礼物的去向说出来。give、send、show 常用 to；buy、make 说“为某人做或买”时常用 for。<#0.8#>
再看 They painted the door red。<#0.7#>the door 是被漆的对象，red 不是又一个被漆的东西，而是说门最后变成什么样。the door 和 red 之间能连成“门是红的”，red 叫宾语补足语。区分时，先问是否有“给谁什么”的传递关系；如果没有，再把宾语和后面内容连成小句。后面是在说明宾语是谁、怎样或做什么，就是宾补，不是第二个宾语。

narration.text:
一个动词像一个会换工服的人。work、works、worked、worked、working 意思都和“工作”有关，但它们在句子里接的任务不同。<#0.8#>
work 是原形，情态动词后会用 can work。<#0.7#>works 用在一般现在时的第三人称单数。worked 可以是过去式，也可以是过去分词，要看它是单独说过去，还是跟 have 或 be 组合。working 常进入进行结构，也能当非谓语。<#0.8#>
不规则动词更能看出区别。<#0.6#>go、goes、went、gone、going 里，went 是过去式，gone 是过去分词，不能在 has 后面说 has went。write 也要记成 write、writes、wrote、written、writing。判断时，不要只背中文词义，先看前面有没有情态动词、have 或 be，再看主语和时间。每学一个新动词，就用“原形、三单、过去式、过去分词、-ing”五格记录，这样才知道它能穿哪件工服。

narration.text:
play → plays · run → runs。<#0.8#>每天的习惯，你说 主语换成第三人称单数时，动词要留下一个小标记。<#0.8#>这个 -s 不是复数，而是一般现在时里，主语为 he、she、it 或一个人事物时的动词标记，叫第三人称单数形式。<#0.8#>
大多数动词直接加 s，play 变 plays，run 变 runs。<#0.6#>watch、wash、fix、go 这类结尾，为了读起来顺口，通常加 es：watches、washes、fixes、goes。辅音字母加 y 结尾的 study，要把 y 变 i 再加 es，成为 studies；have 则直接变 has。<#0.8#>
拼对了还要听读音。likes 的词尾读 /s/，plays 和 runs 读 /z/，watches 读 /iz/，多出一个音节。不用先背一长串术语，可以用嘴巴感受：前面已经是 s、sh、ch 这类嘶声，就需要 /iz/ 把词尾送出来。实际做题先确认是一般现在时和三单主语，再看动词结尾决定 s、es 或 ies，最后读一遍检查发音。

narration.text:
work → worked · live → lived。<#0.8#>要讲昨天的事，work 通常要穿上 -ed，变成 worked。<#0.8#>大多数规则动词就这样表示过去；如果原词已经有 e，live 只加 d，成为 lived，不会写成 liveed。<#0.8#>
有些词在加 -ed 前要整理一下词尾。<#0.6#>study 的 y 前是辅音字母，所以变成 studied。stop 只有一个重读音节，末尾是“辅音、元音、辅音”的紧结构，要双写 p，成为 stopped。但 open 的重音不在最后，通常不双写。<#0.8#>
更需要小心的是 go 和 see。go 的过去式是 went，过去分词是 gone；see 是 saw 和 seen。过去式可以自己做谓语，过去分词常跟 have 或 be 组合，两者不能因为都和过去有关就混用。实际书写时，先判断动词是否规则；规则动词再检查 e、辅音加 y 和重读闭音节；不规则动词则要把“原形、过去式、过去分词”成组调出来。

A postmodifying prepositional phrase does not change the number of the head subject.

narration.text:
一群人踢球和一个男孩踢球，动作一样，但一般现在时的动词要和真正的主角对上号。The boy plays football 里，the boy 是一个人，所以 play 变 plays。<#0.8#>
再看 The boy with his friends plays football。<#0.8#>动词前最近的 friends 是复数，但这句的核心主角仍然是 the boy。with his friends 只补充他和谁一起，不会把主角变成多数。因此仍然用 plays。这种谓语形式跟主语人称和单复数配合的关系，叫主谓一致。<#0.8#>
Tom and Jack play football 则不同。<#0.7#>and 把 Tom 和 Jack 都放进主语，现在是两个人，所以用 play。最常见的错误是只盯着动词前最近的名词。判断时，先框出完整主语，再找它的中心；把 with、of、together with 后的补充暂时遮住；最后看中心是单数，还是由 and 真正连成复数。先找谁在掌控谓语，再选动词形式。

lessons.title: Present simple
examples: She walks to school every day.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: boils states a general fact, not an action limited to this moment.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: every day marks a habit, and She changes walk to walks.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Does carries the question and agreement marking, so like returns to the base form.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: leaves uses the present simple for a fixed timetable.

rules: The present simple expresses facts, states and habitual actions.
A third-person singular affirmative changes the lexical verb form.
Questions and negatives with lexical verbs use do/does plus the base form.
A fixed timetable can use the present simple for a future event.

questions.question: The sun ___ in the east.
questions.correct: Use present simple for a fact.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use present simple for a fact.

questions.question: She ___ English every day.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use studies with third-person singular.

questions.question: ___ he play chess?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use Does + base verb.

questions.question: The film ___ at eight tonight.
questions.correct: A fixed timetable can use starts.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: A fixed timetable can use starts.

narration.text:
水在一百摄氏度沸腾，不是只在你说话的这一秒发生。Water boils at 100 degrees。<#0.8#>这句把事情当作稳定事实来说。She walks to school every day 则是反复出现的习惯。这种说事实、状态和常规习惯的视角，叫一般现在时。<#0.8#>
主语是 he、she、it 或一个人事物时，肯定句的实义动词要用三单，所以是 She walks。<#0.7#>但变疑问时要说 Does he like music？Does 已经拿走三单标记，后面用 like，不是 likes。否定句 它的否定形式 也是同一道理。<#0.8#>
The train leaves at seven 看似未来，却仍用一般现在时，因为列车时刻表是既定安排，说话人把它当作稳定事实。判断时不要只找 every day。先问说话人是否把内容当成稳定状态、反复习惯或固定时刻表；再看主语决定动词原形还是三单；有 do 或 does 时，实义动词恢复原形。

lessons.title: Present progressive
examples: I am staying with my aunt this week.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: is sleeping shows an action in progress now.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: am staying describes a temporary situation during this week.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: is getting highlights a change that is developing now.

rules: The present progressive uses am/is/are + doing for action in progress now.
It can also express a temporary situation around now.
Progressive get/become can highlight an ongoing change.

questions.question: Look! It ___.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Look signals action in progress.

questions.question: This month I ___ by bus.
questions.correct: this month marks a temporary situation.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: this month marks a temporary situation.

questions.question: Days ___ longer.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The progressive highlights change.

narration.text:
现在看一眼宝宝，他正在睡觉。The baby is sleeping now。<#0.8#>这句不是说宝宝平时有睡觉的习惯，而是把镜头对准此刻正在展开的过程。is 负责现在时和主语配合，sleeping 展示动作正在进行，合起来就是现在进行时。<#0.8#>
这个镜头不一定只有一秒。<#0.6#>I am staying with my aunt this week 表示这一周的临时安排，说话时我可能正在学校，但这个阶段仍在持续。The weather is getting warmer 则把气温越来越高的变化展开给我们看。<#0.8#>
结构是 am、is 或 are，加动词的 -ing 形式，两部分都不能丢。只写 只保留宝宝和 sleeping 还没有为这个小句装上现在时。判断时，先问是否在拍一个此刻或当前阶段的动态镜头，还是在陈述稳定习惯；如果是动态镜头，再按主语选 am、is、are，并检查后面是否用 doing。

lessons.title: Past simple
examples: She did not see him yesterday.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: visited places the completed visit in last year.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: did not marks past time and negation, so see stays in the base form.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Did carries past time at the front, so finish returns to the base form.

rules: The past simple expresses a completed past action or state.
A lexical-verb negative uses did not + base form.
A lexical-verb question uses Did + subject + base form.

questions.question: Last night we ___ a film.
questions.correct: Use the past form with a definite past time.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use the past form with a definite past time.

questions.question: She did not ___ home.
questions.correct: Use the base form after did.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use the base form after did.

questions.question: ___ he call you?
questions.correct: Use Did for this lexical-verb past question.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use Did for this lexical-verb past question.

narration.text:
相册里有一张去年苏州的照片。We visited Suzhou last year。<#0.8#>这次旅行放在已经结束的过去时间里，说话人不是在强调它和现在的连接。visited 用过去式把整件事放回了过去，这叫一般过去时。<#0.8#>
否定时，过去的标记会移到 did 上。<#0.6#>She did not see him yesterday 里，did 已经表示过去，所以后面是 see，不是 saw。疑问句 Did you finish the work 也一样，Did 放到主语前，finish 恢复原形。一句里不需要 did 和过去式同时重复标记过去。<#0.8#>
常见的 last year、yesterday、几天前 能帮助定位，但不是只要看到它们就不思考。判断时，先画一条时间线，看事情是否完全落在已结束的过去区间；肯定句用动词过去式；有 did 的否定或疑问句，实义动词立即回到原形。

lessons.title: Future forms
lessons.meta: will · be going to · arranged future
examples: Look at the clouds; it is going to rain.
We are meeting the teacher tomorrow.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: will call expresses a promise or decision made at speaking time.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The clouds are present evidence, so is going to predicts rain.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: are meeting expresses an arranged near-future event.

rules: will + base form can express instant decisions, predictions and promises.
be going to expresses a prior plan or an evidence-based prediction.
The present progressive can express an arranged near future.

questions.question: I think it ___ fine tomorrow.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use will for a prediction.

questions.question: Look at those clouds! It ___.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Present evidence supports going to.

questions.question: We ___ the doctor at 3 p.m. tomorrow.
questions.correct: Use present progressive for an arrangement.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use present progressive for an arrangement.

narration.text:
电话响了，你当场决定“我今晚给你回电话”，可以说 I will call you tonight。<#0.8#>will 常把临时决定、承诺或当下的预测指向未来，后面用动词原形。<#0.8#>
抬头看见乌云已经压下来，你说 It is going to rain。<#0.7#>这不是凭空猜测，而是根据眼前迹象判断。going to 结构 也可以表示已经有的计划。注意 be 要按主语变成 am、is 或 are。<#0.8#>
如果时间和对方都已经安排好，会说 We are meeting the teacher tomorrow。现在进行时放在这里，不是说此刻正在见老师，而是把未来会面当作已排进日程的事。选择时，先问决定是否刚刚做出，是就用 will；再看是否有早已存在的计划或眼前迹象，可用 going to 结构；如果具体安排已落定，就考虑现在进行时。不要只看 tomorrow，要看未来是怎样被说话人想象的。

lessons.title: Verbs and the five basic patterns
examples: I like music. (SVO) · Mum gave me a gift. (SVOO)

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Intransitive verbs form SV; linking verbs form SVC.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Transitive verbs may take one or two objects.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: The object complement describes the object.

rules: SVC contains a linking verb and subject complement.
SVO has one object; SVOO has two.
In SVOC, the complement predicates something of the object.

questions.question: “Birds sing” is ...
questions.wrong: Check the rule: sing has no object.

questions.question: “She gave me a pen” is ...
questions.wrong: Check the rule: There are two objects.

questions.question: “We kept the room clean” is ...
questions.wrong: Check the rule: clean complements room.

narration.text:
Birds fly. (SV) · She is kind. (SVC)。<#0.8#>动词像游戏里不同形状的插槽，有的自己就能完成画面，有的后面必须接一块或两块内容。Birds fly 说完已经成立，只有主语和谓语，叫 SV。<#0.8#>
She is kind 里，is 把 She 和 kind 连起来，kind 说明她怎样，这是 SVC，也就是主系表。<#0.7#>I like music 的 like 直接需要“喜欢什么”，music 是宾语，这是 SVO。Mum gave me a gift 有接收者 me 和东西 a gift，这是 SVOO。<#0.8#>
They made me happy 最容易混。me 是被影响的人，happy 说明 me 最后的状态，两者能连成“我很开心”，所以 happy 是宾补，整体是 SVOC。判句型先找动词，再问它后面必须补“主语怎样”、一个对象、接收者加东西，还是对宾语的说明。暂时去掉时间地点，留下的必需插槽就决定句型。

lessons.title: Be, do and have as auxiliaries

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: are does not name the action; with working it forms the progressive.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Do helps know form a question, and know stays in the base form.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: has and finished together show a completed action relevant now.

rules: be + doing forms the progressive; be + done the passive.
do/does/did supplies questions, negatives and emphasis in simple tenses.
have/has/had + participle forms the perfect.

questions.question: What does are do here?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: are + playing forms the progressive.

questions.question: ___ she like it?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use Does.

questions.question: What does has do here?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: has + left forms the perfect.

narration.text:
be、do、have 单独出现时有自己的意思，但它们也常做幕后助手，帮主要动词搭出不同结构。They are working 里，are 没有表示“是”，它和 working 组合，把动作展示为正在进行。<#0.8#>
当门被关上时 里，be 加过去分词 closed，让门成为动作承受者，这是被动。<#0.7#>Do you know him 里，know 本身没有可以移到主语前的助手，所以 do 来帮它变疑问。否定句 实义动词的否定形式 也靠 do 安放 not。<#0.8#>
She has finished the task 里，has 加过去分词 finished，把任务的完成和现在连起来，这是完成体。判断这三个词的工作，不要只看词形。先看它后面跟的是 doing、done 还是动词原形；be 加 doing 表进行，be 加 done 表被动，have 加 done 表完成，do 则常帮一般时实义动词做疑问、否定或强调。

lessons.title: Core modal meanings

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: can/could express ability or permission.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: They express different force or source of obligation/advice.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: They express degrees of possibility and deduction.

rules: can/could express ability or permission and take a base verb.
must, have to and should express obligation, necessity or advice.
may/might, must and can’t express degrees of deduction.

questions.question: ___ I use your phone?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: May asks permission.

questions.question: You look tired. You ___ rest.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: should gives advice.

questions.question: The light is on. He ___ be home.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: must marks strong deduction.

narration.text:
can/could: ability or permission。<#0.8#>同一个“去”，前面加不同小词，说话人的态度就变了。can 放在动词前 可能是你有能力去，也可能是你被允许去。must 放在动词前 则带着强烈必要性。<#0.8#>
can 和 could 常说能力或请求允许，could 用在请求中通常更委婉。<#0.7#>must 可以表说话人认为必须，have to 常突出外部规定或客观需要，should 更像建议。这些词叫情态动词或情态表达，核心是把说话人的判断加到动作上。<#0.8#>
它们还能表推测。may 表示可能 是可能在家；must 表示肯定推测 不是命令他在家，而是根据线索推断“他肯定在”；can't 表示不可能 表示“不可能在”。判断时，先看语境在说能力、允许、义务、建议还是推测，再根据态度强弱选词。最后检查：can、must、may、should 后面用动词原形，不加 to，也不变三单。

lessons.title: Present perfect versus past simple

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: have visited counts experience up to now without a finished past time.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: since 2020 connects the living from the past to now, so has lived is used.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: last year is a finished past time, so visited is used.

rules: The present perfect expresses experience up to now or a present result.
With since/for, use a durative expression for continuation to now.
A definite finished past time normally takes past simple.

questions.question: I ___ this film twice.
questions.correct: twice marks experience up to now.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: twice marks experience up to now.

questions.question: He ___ here for five years.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use durative live.

questions.question: She ___ yesterday.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: yesterday requires past simple.

narration.text:
你说 I have visited Beijing twice，重点是到现在为止有过两次北京经历，并没有把它钉在某一个已结束的时间。<#0.8#>这种把过去的事与现在经验或结果连起来的说法，用 have 或 has 加过去分词，叫现在完成时。<#0.8#>
She has lived here since 2020 中，since 给出起点，居住从二零二零年一直延伸到现在。<#0.7#>for 则给出延续多久。如果这种延续还没有结束，要选能持续的动词表达，不能用瞬间动作硬拉一段时间。<#0.8#>
We visited Beijing last year 则把旅行放在已经结束的 last year，所以用一般过去时。两者的分界不是“事情发生过没有”，而是说话人是否把镜头连到现在。判断时，先找 yesterday、last year 这类已结束时间，有就优先考虑一般过去时；没有时，再问是否在说截至现在的经历、结果或延续。

lessons.title: Passive voice across tenses
examples: is made · was made · will be made
is being repaired · was being repaired
has been finished · had been finished

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Simple passives change the tense of be.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: A progressive passive uses be + being + done.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: A perfect passive uses have + been + done.

rules: A simple passive uses the relevant form of be + participle.
A progressive passive uses be + being + participle.
A perfect passive uses have/has/had + been + participle.

questions.question: The room ___ every day.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use is cleaned.

questions.question: The road ___ now.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use the progressive passive.

questions.question: The work ___ already.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use has been + participle.

narration.text:
is made · was made · will be made。<#0.8#>工厂介绍一件产品时，往往更关心“它是怎么被制造的”，而不是谁在操作。它在这里被制造 用 is 加过去分词 made，把承受动作的 it 放在主语位置，这是现在时被动。<#0.8#>
时间变化时，主要变的是 be。<#0.7#>was made 是过去制造，will be made 是将被制造。如果镜头正对着维修过程，要说 桥正在被修理，be 加 being 加过去分词，这是进行时被动。<#0.8#>
如果重点是已经完成，可以说 任务已经被完成。has 负责现在完成，been 建立被动，finished 表示具体动作。不要看到三个动词形式就分成三个谓语，它们是一条链。判断时，先确认主语是动作承受者，再确定一般、进行还是完成；最后按顺序搭骨架：一般被动用 be done，进行被动用 进行被动结构，完成被动用 完成被动结构。

lessons.title: Present tense in future clauses
examples: If it rains we will stay home.
I will call you when I arrive.
Even if he is busy he will help.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: will stay marks the future result, while rains states the condition.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The main clause uses will call; the future time clause still uses arrive.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The even if clause uses is for the future concession without will.

rules: In a real future condition, the if-clause uses present simple.
Future time clauses with when/as soon as/until use present simple.
Future concession clauses with even if normally avoid will.

questions.question: If it ___, we will leave.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use present simple.

questions.question: I will tell her when she ___.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use present simple.

questions.question: Even if he ___ busy, he will come.
questions.correct: Avoid will in the concession clause.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Avoid will in the concession clause.

narration.text:
明天是否下雨还没确定，但你可以说 If it rains, we will stay home。<#0.8#>两部分都谈未来，英语却不在 if 后再放 will。if 已经把 rains 标成未来条件，主句 will stay 再说条件成立后的结果。<#0.8#>
时间从句也是同样。<#0.6#>I will call you when I arrive 里，arrive 形式上是一般现在时，意思却由 when 指向未来到达的那一刻。表示“一……就……”的连接词、before、after、until 引出的未来时间从句，通常也这样处理。<#0.8#>
Even if he is busy, he will help 表示即使将来忙，也会帮忙。even if 引出让步条件，从句仍用 is，不用 will be。这个简称“主将从现”，但不能看到从句就套。判断时，先确认 if、when、until、even if 引出的是真实未来条件、时间或让步；是的话，从句用一般现在时表未来，will 通常留在主句。

lessons.title: The infinitive
examples: I need a pen to write with.
She got up early to catch the bus.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: To learn English is one subject, so takes is singular.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: to write with postmodifies pen; pen supplies the understood object of with.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: to catch the bus answers why she got up early, so it marks purpose.

rules: An infinitive can be subject, object or complement.
An infinitive can postmodify a noun or pronoun.
An infinitive commonly marks purpose and can mark result or cause.

questions.question: ___ a language takes time.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: An infinitive can be subject.

questions.question: I need something ___.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The infinitive postmodifies something.

questions.question: He went out ___ milk.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The infinitive marks purpose.

narration.text:
说“学英语需要时间”，英语可以把动作“学”打包成一件事：To learn English takes time。<#0.8#>To learn English 整块站在主语位置，takes 才是负责时间的谓语。to 加动词原形叫不定式，它有动作意思，却能整体去做别的句子工作。<#0.8#>
I need a pen to write with 里，to write with 说明需要一支什么用途的笔，它放在 pen 后面修饰 pen。<#0.7#>介词 with 不能丢，因为普通关系是 用笔书写这层关系。She got up early to catch the bus 里，to catch the bus 回答“为什么早起”，表示目的。<#0.8#>
不定式也能放在动词后补充“想做、决定做”的内容，但不能因为中文有“去做”就乱加 to。判断时，先找整句真正承担时间的谓语，再把 to do 整块圈出来；问它在表示一件事、修饰前面名词，还是回答目的。先找整块的工作，再确定术语。

lessons.title: The gerund

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Reading treats the action as an activity and serves as subject.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: enjoys needs an object, and the gerund dancing fills that position.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: without is a preposition, so saying goodbye is its gerund object.

rules: A gerund can act as subject or complement.
enjoy, finish, mind, avoid and practice take doing.
A preposition takes doing, not an infinitive; this includes prepositional to.

questions.question: ___ is useful.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: A gerund can be subject.

questions.question: She enjoys ___.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: enjoy takes doing.

questions.question: He left without ___.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use doing after a preposition.

narration.text:
Reading helps us 不是一句缺少主语的命令。<#0.8#>Reading 在这里表示“阅读这件事”，整体站在主语位置，helps 才是谓语。动词加 -ing 后保留动作意思，同时像名词一样做主语、宾语或表语，这种用法叫动名词。<#0.8#>
She enjoys dancing 里，dancing 是 enjoys 的宾语，表示她享受跳舞这项活动。<#0.7#>enjoy、finish、mind、avoid、practice 后常选 doing，这是动词自己选择的补足方式，不能只把中文“做”换成任意形式。<#0.8#>
He left without saying goodbye 里，without 是介词，介词后面要放能当名词性内容的 saying goodbye，不用 to say。即使介词本身是 to，如 表示期待的介词结构，后面也用 doing。判断时，先看 -ing 整块是否在句中代表一项活动；再看它是主语、动词宾语还是介词宾语。若前面是介词，直接优先检查 doing。

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Most verbs add -ing directly.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Normally drop silent e; double the final consonant in an eligible stressed CVC verb.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Change final -ie to y before -ing.

rules: Most verbs add -ing directly.
Normally drop silent e; eligible stressed CVC verbs double the final consonant.
Change final -ie to y before adding -ing.

questions.question: What is the -ing form of work?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Add ing directly.

questions.question: What is the -ing form of run?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Double n before ing.

questions.question: What is the -ing form of lie?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Change ie to y.

narration.text:
work → working · play → playing。<#0.8#>给动词加 -ing 时，大多数很直接：work 变 working，play 变 playing。<#0.8#>但有些词尾如果原样保留，会让拼写和发音不匹配，所以加之前要做一个小调整。<#0.8#>
write 末尾的 e 不发音，加 -ing 时去掉 e，成为 writing。<#0.7#>run 只有一个重读音节，词尾是紧的“辅音、元音、辅音”结构，要双写 n，成为 running。这样能保住原来的短元音。open 的重音不在末音节，通常不双写。<#0.8#>
lie 和 die 又是另一类，末尾 ie 先变成 y，再加 ing，得到 lying 和 dying，不写 lieing。实际拼写可以用四步：先看是否为 ie 结尾，是就变 y；再看是否有不发音 e，有就通常去掉；然后检查末音节是否重读且需要双写；都不是，就直接加 -ing。

lessons.title: Phrasal verbs and object position
examples: turn on the light → turn the light on
turn it on ✓ · turn on it ✗

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: A noun object may go between or after a separable phrasal verb.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: A pronoun object must go between the verb and particle.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Prepositional verbs are normally inseparable.

rules: Learn a phrasal verb as a meaning unit and note whether it is separable.
Pronoun placement is a key test of separable phrasal verbs.

questions.question: Please turn ___ on.
questions.correct: Put the pronoun between turn and on.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Put the pronoun between turn and on.

questions.question: She looks ___ her sister.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: look after is inseparable.

questions.question: Which correctly replaces “the box” with a pronoun?
questions.correct: The pronoun must go in the middle.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The pronoun must go in the middle.

narration.text:
老师说 turn on the light，turn 不是让你转身，turn on 合在一起才是“打开”。<#0.8#>动词和后面的小词组成一个新意思，这种组合常叫短语动词。学它时不能只背 turn 和 on 的单独中文，要连同宾语位置一起学。<#0.8#>
turn on 在这个意思下可以拆开，所以 turn on the light 和 turn the light on 都可以。<#0.7#>但宾语换成 it 时，只能说 turn it on，不说 turn on it。短小代词必须放在动词和小品词中间，这是可分短语动词的高频位置。<#0.8#>
look after the child 却不能把 the child 塞进 look 和 after 中间，因为 after 在这里带着自己的介词宾语，这种组合不可分。判断时，先确认两个词是否共同形成一个意思；再查这个组合是否可分；最后把宾语换成 it 测一次。如果是可分结构，it 必须放中间。

lessons.title: Active and passive voice
examples: The letter was written by Tom.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The active sentence makes the agent Tom subject and the letter object.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The passive makes the letter subject and uses was written to show it receives the action.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: The focus is where English is spoken; the agent is unimportant and omitted.

rules: The passive uses be + past participle; the active object becomes subject.
Omit the by-phrase when the agent is unknown or unimportant.

questions.question: The bridge ___ in 2010.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The passive needs was built.

questions.question: What is the passive form of “People speak English”?
questions.wrong: Check the rule: English receives the action.

questions.question: What structure is used in “The window was broken”?
questions.correct: was + past participle forms the passive.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: was + past participle forms the passive.

narration.text:
桌上有一封信，可以先说写信人：Tom wrote the letter。<#0.8#>也可以把镜头转向信：The letter was written by Tom。事情没变，只是被关注的参与者换了。第一句由做动作的人做主语，叫主动语态；第二句由承受动作的 letter 做主语，叫被动语态。<#0.8#>
被动骨架是 be 加过去分词。was 负责过去时，written 说明 letter 承受 write 的动作。<#0.7#>by Tom 只在需要交代写信者时出现。English is spoken worldwide 里，具体谁说不重要，所以不用 by people。<#0.8#>
改被动时，先找主动句中承受动作的宾语，把它放到主语位置；再保留原来时间，选对 be 的形式；然后把实义动词变过去分词。最后问施动者是否未知、不重要或已明显，是的话省掉 by 短语。

lessons.title: Tense and aspect
lessons.meta: Time and the state of an action

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: study with every day presents the action as a repeated habit.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: am studying with now presents the action as in progress.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: have finished links past completion with the present result.

rules: Simple forms express habits or facts, progressive forms ongoing actions, and perfect forms a past-to-present result.
Time markers help, but meaning decides the tense.

questions.question: Look! The dog ___.
questions.correct: Look signals an action in progress.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Look signals an action in progress.

questions.question: She ___ here since 2020.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: since links past and present.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use present simple for facts.

narration.text:
同一个“学英语”，可以选三种镜头。I study English every day 把它当日常习惯；I am studying now 把此刻过程放大；I have finished my homework 把过去完成的事连到现在结果。<#0.8#>这说明时态不只标“过去、现在、未来”，还展示说话人如何看动作。<#0.8#>
一般体常把事当作事实或完整事件，进行体展示过程，完成体建立较早动作与当前参照点的连接。<#0.7#>now、every day、already 只是线索，不是按下就必然得出某时态的按钮。<#0.8#>
判断时先定位参照时间，再问想展示稳定事实、正在进行的过程，还是已完成且与参照点有关的结果。最后才用时间标志检查。先选镜头，再选结构，比只背标志词更稳，也更能解释真实句子。

lessons.title: Non-finite verb basics

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: wants is finite; to leave depends on it and is not another finite predicate.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: Swimming turns the action into a subject; is is the finite predicate.

exampleNotes.title: Word order
exampleNotes.body: broken modifies window before the noun here.

rules: A non-finite verb cannot serve alone as the finite predicate.
to do often suggests purpose or prospect; doing has nominal/progressive force; done often suggests passive/completed meaning.

questions.question: I hope ___ you.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: hope commonly takes to do.

questions.question: ___ is fun.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Reading can act as subject.

questions.question: the ___ door
questions.wrong: Check the rule: closed is a participial modifier.

narration.text:
She wants to leave 里有两个动作意思，但只有 wants 会随主语和时间变化，to leave 只把“离开”打包成她想做的事。<#0.8#>Swimming is good exercise 里，Swimming 表示一项活动，is 才负责时间。The broken window 里，broken 说明 window 承受了破坏。<#0.8#>
这些保留动作意思，却不独立让小句获得时态和主谓一致的形式，叫非谓语。<#0.7#>to do 常把动作看成目标、目的或未展开的事；doing 常把它看成活动或进行画面；done 常带被动或完成视角。<#0.8#>
判断时，先找每个小句中真正承担时间的谓语；再圈出剩下的 to do、doing、done；最后问它整体在句中做主语、宾语、修饰语还是目的说明。这一节只负责分清谓语和非谓语边界，后面再分别学三种形式。

lessons.title: Past progressive
lessons.meta: Action in progress at a past time
examples: I was reading at eight last night.
They were playing when it began to rain.
While Mum was cooking Dad was cleaning

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: was reading shows the action in progress at eight last night.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: were playing is the ongoing background; began is the shorter interrupting event.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: while links two continuing past actions happening at the same time.

rules: The past progressive uses was/were + doing for action in progress at a past time.
when often introduces a shorter event interrupting an ongoing background action.
while often links simultaneous continuing actions.

questions.question: At nine yesterday I ___.
questions.correct: Use past progressive for action in progress then.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use past progressive for action in progress then.

questions.question: I was walking when he ___.
questions.correct: The interrupting event uses past simple.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: The interrupting event uses past simple.

questions.question: While I was reading, she ___.
questions.correct: Use past progressive for simultaneous continuing action.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use past progressive for simultaneous continuing action.

narration.text:
昨晚八点，你像把摄像机放回过去：I was reading at eight last night。<#0.8#>was 把镜头定位在过去，reading 展示当时尚未结束的过程。was 或 were 加 doing，叫过去进行时。<#0.8#>
They were playing when it began to rain 里，玩耍是正在展开的背景，下雨是途中发生的较短事件。<#0.7#>when 常把短事件插入持续背景，但不是见到 when 就必须一进行一过去，还要看动作长短。<#0.8#>
While Mum was cooking, Dad was cleaning 像分屏画面，两个持续动作同时进行。判断时，先找过去参照点，再问那一刻动作是否正在中途；若有两个动作，还要看是背景与插入事件，还是两个同时持续的画面。

lessons.title: Past perfect, future-in-the-past and sequence
examples: The train had left before we arrived.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: had left occurred before arrived: the train left first.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: said is past, and would return is future viewed from that past point.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: was tired shifts the state into the past viewpoint set by said.

rules: Past perfect had + done expresses an earlier past.
would + base expresses future viewed from the past.
An object clause after past reporting normally shifts to a past viewpoint; universal truths are excepted.

questions.question: By then the film ___.
questions.correct: Use past perfect for the earlier event.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use past perfect for the earlier event.

questions.question: He said he ___ come.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use would.

questions.question: She said she ___ ill.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Shift to the past viewpoint.

narration.text:
到车站时，火车已经开走：The train had left before we arrived。<#0.8#>到达是过去参照点，had left 把开走放在它之前，所以叫“过去的过去”，结构是 had 加过去分词。<#0.8#>
He said he would return 中，said 把观察点带回过去，对当时的他来说，“回来”还在未来，所以用 would 加原形。<#0.7#>She said she was tired 里，疲惫与过去说话情境对应，所以 is 后移为 was。<#0.8#>
但转述仍成立的客观真理，不必机械后移。做题先标出过去参照点；早于它的动作考虑 had done，晚于它的过去未来考虑 would do；转述内容则问是否要保持过去视角。先排清事件先后，再选时态，不要只看某一个时间词。

examples: The book written by Lu Xun is famous.

analyses.text: The book written by Lu Xun
analyses.label: Past-participle postmodifier

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: crying shows that the baby actively produces the ongoing action.

exampleNotes.title: Word order
exampleNotes.body: The postmodifier moves before the noun in Chinese.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: she is the understood subject of Walking home; she saw Tom on the way home.

rules: An -ing participle normally carries active or ongoing meaning.
A past participle normally carries passive or completed meaning.
A participial phrase can modify a noun or clause; an adverbial participle normally shares the main subject.

questions.question: the ___ girl
questions.correct: Use smiling for the active relation.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use smiling for the active relation.

questions.question: the letter ___ yesterday
questions.correct: Use written for a passive completed relation.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use written for a passive completed relation.

questions.question: ___ home, I met Tom.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: I is the understood subject.

narration.text:
The crying baby 里，宝宝正在哭，crying 和 baby 是主动关系，带着进行画面。<#0.8#>The book written by Lu Xun 里，书是 write 的承受者，written 带着被动和完成视角。doing 和 done 这样修饰名词或补充画面时，叫分词。<#0.8#>
written by Lu Xun 整块后置修饰 book，中文理解时通常前移成“鲁迅写的书”。<#0.7#>Walking home, she saw Tom 里，Walking home 不修饰某个名词，而是给整个主句补充背景。<#0.8#>
这时要问“谁在 walking”，答案必须能和主句主语 she 对上。判断时，先找分词所指的名词或逻辑主语；再问它们是主动还是被动、动作正展开还是已完成；主动进行倾向 doing，被动完成倾向 done。

lessons.title: Causative and perception verbs
examples: I saw him cross the road.
I saw him crossing the road.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: us is the object of made, and laugh predicates the action of us.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: cross uses the base form to present the complete event seen.

exampleNotes.title: Example focus
exampleNotes.body: crossing focuses on the action in progress at the moment of seeing.

rules: make/let take object + base; passive make restores to.
Perception verb + object + base emphasizes a complete event.
Perception verb + object + doing emphasizes action in progress.

questions.question: The teacher made us ___.
questions.correct: Active make takes a base verb.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Active make takes a base verb.

questions.question: I saw him ___ and leave.
questions.correct: Use the base for the complete event.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use the base for the complete event.

questions.question: I saw him ___ when I arrived.
questions.correct: Use doing for action in progress.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use doing for action in progress.

narration.text:
The joke made us laugh 表示笑话让我们笑。<#0.8#>made 的对象是 us，laugh 说明 us 做了什么。主动句里，make 和 let 后用“宾语加动词原形”，不加 to。但改成 改成被动后 时，to 要恢复。<#0.8#>
I saw him cross the road 把过马路当作从开始到结束的完整事件，所以用原形 cross。<#0.7#>I saw him crossing the road 只拍到他当时正在过，不说明是否看到全过程，所以用 crossing。这两种都是宾语加宾语补足语。<#0.8#>
判断时，先找 make、let、see、hear、watch 后的宾语，再问后一个动作是谁做的。若表“使让”或感知到完整过程，用原形；若镜头只落在正进行的片段，用 doing。最后检查 make 是否改被动，是的话补回 to。

lessons.title: Meaning changes with doing and to do

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Recall a past action ↔ remember a duty.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: End the action ↔ pause to do another.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
exampleNotes.body: Test a method ↔ make an effort.

rules: remember/forget doing recalls a past action; to do concerns a duty.
stop doing ends the action; stop to do pauses for another.
try doing tests a method; try to do makes an effort.

questions.question: Remember the duty to turn off the light.
questions.correct: Use to do for a duty.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use to do for a duty.

questions.question: He ended the activity of smoking.
questions.correct: Use doing to end the activity.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use doing to end the activity.

questions.question: Test restarting as a method.
questions.correct: Use doing to test a method.
questions.wrong: Check the rule: Use doing to test a method.

narration.text:
形式相近，意义不同：remember doing ↔ remember to do。<#0.8#>出门前想起“还要关灯”，说 remember to do；回家后回想“我记得关过了”，说 remember doing。<#0.8#>to do 指向当时未完成的任务，doing 指向已发生、可回想的事。<#0.8#>
stop doing 是停止抽烟；stop to do 是停下原来的事，目的是抽烟。<#0.7#>doing 是被停止的事，to do 是停下后要做的新事。try doing 是试试重启这个办法；try to do 是努力把它重启成功。<#0.8#>
判断时不只背“某词后接 doing 或 to do”。先问动作已发生还是待完成，是原来的事还是新目的，是试验办法还是努力完成。把两个动作的先后和关系说清，再选 doing 或 to do。

lessons.meta: to be done · being done · having done
examples: Having finished the work, she left.

exampleNotes.body: Passive non-finite forms retain a passive relation.

exampleNotes.title: Rule focus
